description: This file defines the class MessageOnlyLogFilter, which implements the LogNode interface. It acts as a filter in a logging chain, passing only message content to the next node, omitting metadata like tags, priorities, or throwables. The class is part of a logging utility package within an Android project.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A log filter class that passes only message strings to the next LogNode in the chain, ignoring metadata such as tags or priorities.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that takes the next LogNode in the chain as parameter.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Processes log entries, forwarding only the message to the next LogNode if it exists.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
